A lover of the most beautiful sport in the world (football); I run in the mornings and read at night.

about.title: About - Mauricio Peón
about.metaDescription: Full-stack engineer, co-founder and CTO of Medu. Experience, technical stack, education, talks and projects by Mauricio Peón.
about.heading: I'm Mauricio Peón: engineer, co-founder and CTO of Medu.
bio: In 2019 I co-founded Medu, a Spanish-language medical education platform. I designed and built the product from scratch — the web app, the iOS and Android apps, the APIs and the AWS infrastructure — and grew it to **200,000+ health professionals in 21 countries**, with 31 courses and 146 live surgeries.

Along the way the team grew to 20 people across engineering, product and content, and I stayed hands-on in the code every day. I also closed and delivered enterprise accounts with **Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk and Pfizer**, owning both the technical integration and the commercial relationship.

Today I focus on getting AI into production for real: Spanish medical speech-to-text, clinical case generation and audio learning, with evaluation, cost control and latency handled end to end. Outside Medu I build my own apps — ¿Te tocó?, Guardia and a meditation app on the way — and share what I learn on panels and in a technology column.

I studied Computer Science & Technology Engineering at Tecnológico de Monterrey and an M.S. in Data Science, Big Data & AI at Universidad Complutense de Madrid. Away from the screen, I run: I finished the Valencia Marathon 2025 in 3:51.

experience.title: Experience
medu: Architected and built the entire product from scratch: Next.js web app, React Native apps for iOS and Android, REST APIs, and AWS infrastructure (Amplify, Lambda, S3, CloudFront).
Scaled to **200,000+ health professionals in 21 countries** with 31 courses and 146 live surgeries; grew and led a team of 20 across engineering, product and content.
Closed and delivered enterprise accounts with **Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk and Pfizer**, owning both the technical integration and the commercial relationship.
Built video streaming infrastructure for live surgical broadcasts handling thousands of concurrent viewers, including adaptive delivery and graceful degradation on unreliable hospital networks.

Shipped LLM features to production, not prototypes: Spanish medical speech-to-text, clinical case generation, and AI-generated audio learning — with evaluation, cost control and latency handled end to end.
Built complex interactive interfaces: clinical case simulators and real-time gamified quiz systems.
Led product strategy and enterprise sales while writing code daily — full ownership from infrastructure to UI to revenue.
ibm: Developed ETL pipelines and data solutions for banking clients using SQL databases.
Translated complex business requirements into technical specifications across cross-functional teams.
